mines.mine_notes: 100%-owned, Potosi Department, Bolivia (~35 km NE of Cerro Rico; 5.42 km2 property). June 2024 PFS (tech report Aug 8, 2024, eff. June 19, 2024, AMC Mining Consultants): 13-year open-pit tank-leach (Merrill-Crowe) mine life (excl. 2-yr pre-production); ~157 Moz payable silver total; avg >12 Moz/yr (>15 Moz/yr years 1-3); post-tax NPV5% US$740M, IRR 37% @ US$24/oz Ag; initial capex US$358M; sustaining/closure capex US$85M; payback 1.9 yrs; LOM AISC US$10.69/oz Ag. Mining contractor initially. Next steps: community surface-rights agreements, ESIA submission, illegal-miner resolution. No production yet.

Silver-lead-zinc project, Oruro, Bolivia (~10 hrs drive from Silver Sand). PEA-stage: NPV ~US$500M @ US$24/oz Ag. Resources: indicated 214 Mt @ 81 g/t AgEq = 560 Moz AgEq (incl. 30 g/t Ag = 205 Moz Ag, 0.3 g/t Au = 1,587 koz, 0.3% Pb, 0.6% Zn); inferred 44 Mt @ 91 g/t AgEq = 110 Moz AgEq. No production.

notes: Silver developer; no production or revenue in FY2025 (fiscal year ends June 30). Pan American Silver holds 19.9%. CEO & President Andrew Williams. Silver Sand is one of the world's largest undeveloped high-grade silver deposits; combined Silver Sand + Carangas M&I silver-eq resources 762 Moz. FY2026 (ended June 30, 2026) net loss US$4.2M. All project economics in USD.
